title: feat(ui): shared components and styles from the website v2 polish
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Expanded @pollinations/ui with shared EmptyState, SocialCount, IconTile, LiveDot, Skeleton and StableLabel components, and bumped the package to 0.1.0-alpha.10. StableLabel moved out of Enter’s top-up panel into the shared package. FileUpload was reworked, Button and TabButton gained new intents and an icon slot, and ModalityTab now uses that slot instead of rendering a second icon. The PR also updates shared tokens, styles and other UI components for the website v2 design.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and helps arrange reusable interface tiles beside a retro monitor, with flowers growing around prominent lime green (#ecf874) panels and soft pastel gradients. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, never oversized or dominating it, in strictly pixel art style, never realistic; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
